name: Vitrail
author: E. T. Carter
description: A stained-glass rose window built from the mirror-fold: concentric rings of leaded panes wheel around a bright central boss, each ring glowing its own palette hue. A slow tide of light blooms outward through the glass ring by ring while the whole window turns almost imperceptibly; the dark lead cames stay black so the panes read as backlit glass.

params.label: Panes per ring
params.effect: Mirror-fold count — how many panes circle each ring (floored in-shader); few reads as broad lights, many as fine tracery.

params.label: Rings
params.effect: Number of concentric pane rings from boss to rim.

params.label: Lead width
params.effect: Thickness of the dark lead cames between panes — thin for big glass, thick for a heavy leaded look.

params.label: Light tide
params.effect: Speed of the light blooming outward through the rings; at 0 the glass holds a steady glow.
